code: preview_dir <- if (isTRUE(getOption("knitr.in.progress"))) {   file.path(tempdir(), "bodybuildr-tutorial")   # building the vignette: keep files out of the way } else {   "bodybuildr-tutorial"                         # running the script: next to you } dir.create(preview_dir, showWarnings = FALSE) .preview_n <- 0  preview <- function(x, width = 6, height = NULL, theme = NULL) {   .preview_n <<- .preview_n + 1   file <- file.path(preview_dir, sprintf("step-%02d.pdf", .preview_n))    if (inherits(x, c("bb_page", "bb_document"))) {     # A finished page or document: export it as it is.     export_pdf(x, file)   } else {     # A loose block: make a page just big enough to hold it.     margin <- 0.2     if (is.null(height)) {       h <- with_theme(theme, as.numeric(measure_block(x, width - 2 * margin)))       height <- if (is.na(h)) 2.5 else h + 2 * margin   # NA = "flexible", see Part 1     }     tpl <- page_template(width = width, height = height, margin_x = margin,                          margin_top = margin, margin_bottom = margin,                          theme = theme, background = "white")     export_pdf(bb_page(x, template = tpl), file)   }    in_knitr <- isTRUE(getOption("knitr.in.progress"))   if (!in_knitr || !requireNamespace("pdftools", quietly = TRUE)) {     message("Wrote ", file)     return(invisible(file))   }   n <- pdftools::pdf_info(file)$pages   pngs <- vapply(seq_len(n), function(i) knitr::fig_path(".png", number = sprintf("%02d-%d", .preview_n, i)),                  character(1))   dir.create(dirname(pngs[1]), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)   pdftools::pdf_convert(file, dpi = 150, filenames = pngs, verbose = FALSE)   knitr::include_graphics(pngs, dpi = 150) }

title: Showcase: three very different documents
text: pages use built-blocks, dashboard needs pieces : KPI tile sparkline, progress meter thin horizontal line. make custom block new_block() giving two functions: measure(width): tall block given width, inches. render(width, height): drawing , grid grob, made box exactly size. , custom block works like built-one. can sit stacks, columns, boxes table cells, follows page’s theme.
code: # How tall is one line of text in a given style? bodybuildr works in inches: # the font size is in points and there are 72 points in an inch. line_in <- function(style, role = "body") {   gp <- text_gpar(style, role)   gp$fontsize * gp$lineheight / 72 }  # Look up a colour by its theme name (such as "accent"). If the name isn't # in the theme, assume it is already a normal colour (such as "#FF0000"). theme_col <- function(x) bb_get_theme()$colors[[x]] %||% x  # --- Block 1: a thin horizontal line ------------------------------------------ # Its height is the line's thickness (line widths are measured in 1/96 in). hrule <- function(color = "ink", lwd = 1, lty = "solid") {   new_block("hrule",     measure = function(width) lwd / 96,     render = function(width, height) {       segmentsGrob(x0 = 0, y0 = 0.5, x1 = 1, y1 = 0.5,                    gp = gpar(col = theme_col(color), lwd = lwd, lty = lty, lineend = "butt"))     }) }  # --- Block 2: a KPI tile ------------------------------------------------------ # Layout, top to bottom: #   LABEL                 ▲ 1.9% #   4.82 AU #   ~~~~~ sparkline ~~~~~ # Its height is worked out from the text styles, so a theme with bigger text # makes taller tiles without any other change. kpi_tile <- function(label, value, delta, series, good = "up") {   label_style <- text_style("small", weight = 700)   value_style <- text_style(size = 22, weight = 700)   delta_style <- text_style("small", weight = 700)   spark_height <- 0.32   # inches reserved for the sparkline   spacing <- 0.05        # inches between the three rows    new_block("kpi",     measure = function(width) {       line_in(label_style) + spacing + line_in(value_style) + spacing + spark_height     },     render = function(width, height) {       theme <- bb_get_theme()        # Is this change good news? Green if so, red if not.       went_up <- delta >= 0       is_good <- if (good == "up") went_up else !went_up       delta_gp <- text_gpar(delta_style)       delta_gp$col <- theme$status[[if (is_good) "yes" else "no"]]        # grid measures y from the bottom; this turns "inches from the top"       # into a grid position.       from_top <- function(inches) unit(1, "npc") - unit(inches, "in")       value_baseline <- line_in(label_style) + spacing + line_in(value_style)        # Scale the series to 0-1 in both directions for the sparkline.       xs <- (seq_along(series) - 1) / (length(series) - 1)       ys <- (series - min(series)) / max(diff(range(series)), 1e-9)       spark_area <- viewport(y = 0, height = unit(spark_height, "in"), just = "bottom")        gTree(children = gList(         # The label, in capitals (text_gpar() supplies font, size and colour;         # the letter case is applied here).         textGrob(toupper(label), x = 0, y = from_top(0), just = c("left", "top"),                  gp = text_gpar(label_style)),         # The change, top right, with an up or down arrow.         textGrob(sprintf("%s%.1f%%", if (went_up) "▲ " else "▼ ", abs(delta)),                  x = unit(1, "npc"), y = from_top(0), just = c("right", "top"), gp = delta_gp),         # The big number.         textGrob(value, x = 0, y = from_top(value_baseline), just = c("left", "bottom"),                  gp = text_gpar(value_style)),         # The sparkline: a faint filled area, the line, and a dot on the latest value.         gTree(vp = spark_area, children = gList(           polygonGrob(c(xs, 1, 0), c(ys, 0, 0),                       gp = gpar(fill = adjustcolor(theme$colors$primary, 0.15), col = NA)),           linesGrob(xs, ys, gp = gpar(col = theme$colors$primary, lwd = 1.4)),           pointsGrob(1, ys[length(ys)], pch = 19, size = unit(3, "pt"),                      gp = gpar(col = theme$colors$accent))))       ))     }) }  # --- Block 3: a progress meter ------------------------------------------------ # A rounded grey track with a coloured part filled in. Small enough for a # table cell. meter <- function(fraction, color = "primary", height = 0.08) {   fraction <- max(0, min(1, fraction))   # keep it between 0% and 100%   new_block("meter",     measure = function(width) height,     render = function(width, height) gTree(children = gList(       roundrectGrob(r = unit(height / 2, "in"),                     gp = gpar(fill = theme_col("rule_light"), col = NA)),       roundrectGrob(x = 0, width = unit(fraction, "npc"), just = "left", r = unit(height / 2, "in"),                     gp = gpar(fill = theme_col(color), col = NA))))) }  # A custom block measures itself like any other: measure_block(kpi_tile("Test", "42", 1, 1:5), width = 2) #> [1] 0.988055555555556inches
